web_fixture.title: Railcards | Fennmoor Rail
web_fixture.content:
# Railcards

Eligibility from 1 March 2026:

- Youth Railcard: ages 16-25
- Senior Railcard: age 60 or over (lowered in February 2026)
- Family Railcard: 1-4 adults with 1-4 children
